mapper.select: select e.explanation_id, e.assessment_id, e.explain_status, e.claim_token, cast(e.ai_output as text) as ai_output, e.ai_status, e.call_id, e.error_msg, coalesce(e.result_computed_time = r.computed_time, false) as is_current, e.create_time, e.update_time from abr_report_explanation e left join abr_assessment_result r on r.assessment_id = e.assessment_id where e.assessment_id = #{assessmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_report_explanation (assessment_id, result_computed_time, explain_status, claim_token, started_time, create_time, update_time) select r.assessment_id, r.computed_time, 'running', #{claimToken}, now(), now(), now() from abr_assessment_result r where r.assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and r.computed_time is not null on conflict (assessment_id) do update set result_computed_time = excluded.result_computed_time, explain_status = 'running', claim_token = excluded.claim_token, ai_output = null, ai_status = null, call_id = null, error_msg = null, started_time = now(), finished_time = null, update_time = now() where abr_report_explanation.result_computed_time <> excluded.result_computed_time or (abr_report_explanation.explain_status = 'running' and abr_report_explanation.started_time < now() - cast(#{staleSeconds} as integer) * interval '1 second')
mapper.update: update abr_report_explanation set explain_status = #{explainStatus}, ai_output = cast(#{aiOutput} as jsonb), ai_status = #{aiStatus}, call_id = #{callId}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and claim_token = #{claimToken}
